class.name: BinauralRenderer
class.brief_description: Binaural rendering of audio channels or an ambisonic sound field as virtual speakers, through an HRTF.
class.description: Every source (a channel at a position in the world) is heard through the head-related transfer function of its direction from the listener's head: a fractional delay line per ear (the interaural delay) and a 128-tap FIR with the bilinearly interpolated, delay-free impulse response of a 48 x 14 grid of directions. The listener's pose is followed every 64 frames, the old and new filters crossfaded, so head turns make no clicks. No block processing: no latency. Ambisonics (AmbiX: ACN, SN3D; orders 1 to 3) are decoded to world-fixed virtual speakers with max-rE weights and rendered the same way. A room adds first-order reflections off the walls of a box (image sources) and a late reverb (a feedback delay network sized to the room). Then an output EQ and a gain. The setters can be called from any thread; [method process] (the audio thread, through [method MediaSource.set_spatial_renderer]) takes their state at its next call. [method render] runs it from a script, for tests. HRTFs: a pack (the compact grid this class writes with [method save_hrtf]) or a SOFA file (AES69 SimpleFreeFieldHRIR, read with libmysofa, resampled to 48 kHz, diffuse-field equalised).

method.name: ambisonic_encode
method.description: Returns the AmbiX (ACN, SN3D) gains of a plane wave from [param direction] (Godot axes), for tests.

method.name: get_hrtf_info
method.description: Returns [code]loaded[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]credit[/code], [code]source[/code], [code]measured[/code] (directions in the SOFA file it came from) and [code]grid[/code].

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns why the last [method load_hrtf] failed.

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description: Returns the output rate set with [method set_sample_rate].

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns [code]frames[/code], [code]calls[/code], [code]usec[/code] (CPU time spent), [code]load[/code] (CPU time per second of audio: the share of one core), [code]max_usec[/code], [code]max_frames[/code], [code]sources[/code] and [code]latency_frames[/code] (0).

method.name: get_tuning
method.description: Returns [code]itd_scale[/code], [code]pinna_warp[/code] and [code]concha_db[/code].

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once an HRTF is loaded.

method.name: load_hrtf
method.description: Loads a pack, or a [code].sofa[/code] file. On failure [method get_last_error] says why.

method.name: lookup_hrir
method.description: Returns the interpolated responses ([code]left[/code], [code]right[/code]) and delays ([code]delay_left[/code], [code]delay_right[/code], samples) for a direction: azimuth in degrees from the front, positive to the right; elevation positive up. For tests.

method.name: render
method.description: Renders [param input] (interleaved, [param channels] per frame) to interleaved stereo, in blocks of 512 frames, as the audio thread would.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the delay lines and the room's echoes at the next block (a seek).

method.name: reset_stats
method.description: Starts [method get_stats] again.

method.name: save_hrtf
method.description: Writes the loaded HRTF as a pack, with [param name] and [param credit] if given.

method.name: set_ambisonics
method.description: Decodes an ambisonic sound field of [param order] (0: none) from the inputs starting at [param first_input], its front turned by [param frame] in the world (the 360 picture's front).

method.name: set_eq
method.description: The output EQ: up to 8 Dictionaries [code]{type: "peak", "low_shelf" or "high_shelf", freq, gain_db, q}[/code].

method.name: set_gain
method.description: The output gain.

method.name: set_listener
method.description: The head's pose in the world (the XR camera's global transform). Blocks in between are interpolated.

method.name: set_room
method.description: [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code] (the walls' box in the world), [code]reflect[/code] (0-1, or six: left, right, floor, ceiling, front, back), [code]rt60[/code] (seconds), [code]wet[/code] (0-2), [code]late[/code] (the reverb's level at wet 1, default 0.5), [code]enabled[/code].

method.name: set_sample_rate
method.description: The output's sample rate; the HRTF is resampled to it. [method MediaSource.set_spatial_renderer] sets it.

method.name: set_sources
method.description: Up to 48 Dictionaries: [code]input[/code] (the channel), [code]kind[/code] ("point", "lfe": both ears without direction, "head_left" / "head_right": head-locked), [code]position[/code] (world; with [code]at_infinity[/code] a direction), [code]gain[/code], [code]reflections[/code].

method.name: set_tuning
method.description: Fits the HRTF to a listener: the interaural delay times [param itd_scale] (0.5-1.5, head size), the responses' spectral features moved up by [param pinna_warp] (0.8-1.25, the pinna notches), and a peak of [param concha_db] at 4.5 kHz (the concha's resonance).

method.name: virtual_speakers
method.description: Returns the directions of the ambisonic decode's virtual speakers for [param order] (8, 12 or 26).
